answer: Three things stand between a cheat and a licence: the book, the stamp and the sworn witness. Button maker mould tally with button makers attestation holds all three together: six-year tally, 100,000 buttons cast, mould accounts, quarterly audit. Forge the zephyr and the licence is void on the spot, the forger pays three times the fee and the violet is seized as security, while the orchard is written down and read aloud at the next quarterly meeting.
